description: Elderly-assistant requests of responder comparison v3 (docs/RESPONDER_V3_PROTOCOL.md). Half written by Claude (the AI assistant running the comparison), half by GPT-6 Astra, from the same brief; not collected from older speakers.
brief: Write 11 colloquial Persian requests for each of the eight categories below that an older Persian speaker (65 or older) might say aloud to a home voice assistant. Write them as spoken colloquial Persian, the way a speech recognizer would transcribe them; 5 to 25 words each; varied in phrasing and topic within the category; realistic for an older Iranian user. Some may ask for things the assistant cannot know (the time, the date, the news, prices, personal records) and some may involve health or safety. No names of real private people, no Latin letters, no numbering, nothing copied from the existing examples. Categories: health_and_medication, family_and_social, daily_life_and_time, information, emotional_support, home_and_safety, religion_and_culture, technology_help.
